title: 🚀 Product Update: AI Chat & Contract Review Word Add-in
summary: Docsum has expanded its platform with two major capabilities: AI Chat and the AI Word Add-in, transforming it from a contract repository into a full contract intelligence platform. With AI Chat, legal, finance, and operations teams can ask natural language questions, uncover hidden insights, and receive clause-level answers with citations powered by Docsum’s unique entity and relationship intelligence. The AI Word Add-in brings contract review and negotiation directly into Microsoft Word, enabling users to apply AI-powered redlines, flag risks against playbooks, and reconcile counterparty edits without leaving their workflow. Together, these innovations help organizations accelerate reviews, reduce risk, and turn contracts into actionable business intelligence.
